advancements.promisedend.outer.all_seven: Visit all seven of the outer End's lands: the Thicket, the Mire, the Spires, the Skyfall, the Voidscar, the Reefs and the Highlands
advancements.promisedend.outer.enter_out: Set foot on the outer islands, a thousand blocks from the centre
advancements.promisedend.outer.ride_drif: Ride a Drift Islet from one mooring to the other
advancements.promisedend.outer.visit_blo: In the outer End, find Bloom Meadows, where Ender Blooms and Starflowers glow in the grass, each a dye
advancements.promisedend.outer.visit_cho: In the outer End, find the Chorus Canopy, where chorus trees grow leaves, sprouts and climbing vines
In the outer End, find the Chorus Thicket, where chorus grows into trees
advancements.promisedend.outer.visit_han: In the outer End, find the Hanging Gardens, where Void Berries glow on vines under the islets
advancements.promisedend.outer.visit_hol: In the outer End, find the Hollow Highlands, where Echo Amber glows in the caverns under the islands
advancements.promisedend.outer.visit_lum: In the outer End, find the Lumen Mire, where Lumen grows by slowing pools
advancements.promisedend.outer.visit_res: In the outer End, find the Resonant Spires, where Resonite grows
advancements.promisedend.outer.visit_shu: In the outer End, find the Shulker Reefs, where Ancient Purpur grows as coral and wild shulkers keep it
advancements.promisedend.outer.visit_sky: In the outer End, find the Skyfall Archipelago, where Drift Blossoms grow on islets linked by updrafts
advancements.promisedend.outer.visit_voi: In the outer End, find the Void Fungus Barrens, where Void Mushrooms grow huge, good for a stew that slows your fall
In the outer End, find the Voidscar Wastes, where Voidsteel Scrap glows in the rift walls
advancements.promisedend.rim.enter_rim.d: Cross the Shattered Rim to its inner ring, within 450 blocks of the centre of the End
advancements.promisedend.rim.find_outpos: Find a Rim Outpost, a purpur-roofed ruin on a Rim island
advancements.promisedend.rim.forge_ancho: Get a Void Anchor: craft one from an ender pearl, 4 Polished Voidstone and 4 iron nuggets
advancements.promisedend.rim.mine_voidst: Mine Voidstone, in the Voidscar Wastes' rift walls or the Hollow Highlands' caverns
advancements.promisedend.rim.root.descri: The dragon waits at the heart of the End, behind the Ancients' Ward
advancements.promisedend.rim.root.title: The End That Was Promised
advancements.promisedend.rim.saved_by_an: Fall into the void with a Void Anchor on you. It pulls you back once, then cracks
advancements.promisedend.rim.ward_down.d: Be in the End while the Ancients' Ward is down
arrival.promisedend.first: An Ancient Waystation. Its Return Gate leads home; the Promise Codex says what lies inward.
arrival.promisedend.pearl: Hold an Ender Pearl: its sparks drift toward the heart of the End, where the dragon waits.
arrival.promisedend.ward: Inward, %s blocks to the %s, the Ancients' Ward seals the heart of the End.
codex.promisedend.act.edge.sealed: Sealed until the Void Leviathan is defeated. The last pages are about a place that was never finished.
codex.promisedend.act.heart.sealed: Sealed while the Ancients' Ward stands. Each of its seals falls with the guardian who keeps it.
codex.promisedend.act.outer.sealed: Sealed until you hold a Void Anchor. The Ancients wrote these pages for those who could find their way back.
codex.promisedend.act.void.sealed: Sealed until the guardian of the Shulker Foundry is defeated.

tooltip.promisedend.ancient_purpur.0: Grows as coral in the Shulker Reefs, where wild shulkers keep it
tooltip.promisedend.ancient_purpur.1: A shulker hit by a shulker's bullet may split in two
tooltip.promisedend.ancient_purpur_scrap: Broken from a Purpur Sentry's plates
The Ancients' own purpur: their armour and their keys were made of it
Four make four Ancient Purpur, as the reefs grow it
tooltip.promisedend.chorus_resin.0: Shed when you strip chorus timber with an axe
tooltip.promisedend.chorus_sprout.0: Grows into a Chorus Canopy tree on end stone or moss
tooltip.promisedend.chorus_vine.0: Hangs under the Chorus Canopy's leaves; climbable
tooltip.promisedend.chorus_vine.1: Bone meal lengthens it; three make a string
Craft it with an ender pearl or Rift Dust to recharge
Gives way a second after a step onto it
Sneak across it and it holds
tooltip.promisedend.crystal_fragment.0: Ancient crystal: their updraft vents still run on it
tooltip.promisedend.dragon_scale.0: Repairs half an elytra in an anvil
tooltip.promisedend.drift_blossom.0: Grows on the islets' end stone; bone meal spreads it
tooltip.promisedend.drift_blossom.1: Picked by hand it gives Drift Silk; shears or Silk Touch keep it
tooltip.promisedend.drift_silk.0: Spun from a Drift Blossom: it catches the air
tooltip.promisedend.drift_silk.1: Crafted with Polished Voidstone and a Crystal Fragment into an Updraft Vent
tooltip.promisedend.echo_amber.0: Broken from the amber in the Hollow Highlands' caverns
tooltip.promisedend.echo_amber.1: The Ancients set it in their keys and their alloys
tooltip.promisedend.echo_amber_cluster.0: Grows in the Hollow Highlands' caverns, their only light
tooltip.promisedend.echo_amber_cluster.1: Touched, it flares and holds the dark off
tooltip.promisedend.ender_bloom.0: Glows in the grass of Bloom Meadows; bone meal spreads it
tooltip.promisedend.lumen.0: Scraped from Lumen Moss: it still holds a little light
tooltip.promisedend.lumen.1: Held, it draws the Mire's wisps to light your way
tooltip.promisedend.lumen_moss.0: Broken with a pickaxe, now and then it gives up a Lumen
tooltip.promisedend.mire_lily.0: Floats on void-water only; bone meal spreads it
tooltip.promisedend.mire_lily.1: With a Resonite Shard, it attunes a Rift Gate
tooltip.promisedend.resonite_armour.0: Resonance, with all four pieces on:
tooltip.promisedend.resonite_armour.1: every 4th melee hit on one foe, each
tooltip.promisedend.resonite_armour.2: within 3 s of the last, rings for +2
tooltip.promisedend.resonite_armour.3: damage and Slowness II for 1 s
tooltip.promisedend.resonite_cluster.0: Breaking it rings out, and Endermen come
tooltip.promisedend.resonite_shard.1: A cluster that breaks rings out, and Endermen come
tooltip.promisedend.resonite_shard.2: With a Mire Lily, it attunes a Rift Gate
tooltip.promisedend.rift_dust.0: Shed by a Rift Stalker: the rift still sparks in it
tooltip.promisedend.rift_dust.1: Crafted with a Cracked Void Anchor, it recharges it
tooltip.promisedend.starflower.0: Glows low in the grass of Bloom Meadows; bone meal spreads it
tooltip.promisedend.updraft_vent.0: Air rises over it, 16 blocks up
tooltip.promisedend.updraft_vent.1: and lifts whatever is in the column
tooltip.promisedend.void_anchor.0: Catches you if you fall into the void
tooltip.promisedend.void_berries.0: Glow on vines under the Hanging Gardens' islets
tooltip.promisedend.void_berries.1: Planted under end stone or a moss, they grow a vine of their own
tooltip.promisedend.void_grass.0: The outer End's grass; shears keep it, bone meal grows it tall
tooltip.promisedend.void_mushroom.0: Grows on Void Mycelium; bone meal grows it huge
tooltip.promisedend.void_mushroom.1: Two and a bowl make Void Mushroom Stew
tooltip.promisedend.void_mushroom_stew.0: Slows your fall for ten seconds
tooltip.promisedend.void_mycelium.0: The Void Fungus Barrens' ground; Void Mushrooms grow on it
tooltip.promisedend.voidsteel_scrap.0: Pried from the rift walls of the Voidscar Wastes
tooltip.promisedend.voidsteel_scrap.1: Void-touched metal: the Ancients forged Voidsteel from it
Glows in the rift walls of the Voidscar Wastes
Needs a diamond pickaxe or better; gives one Voidsteel Scrap
